items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Down Moore and Harvey, wasn't it? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Harvey?

ctx.x: Down Moore and Harvey, wasn't it? What were some of the other places you played?
Wasn't it down the road a little bit farther, away from the river, on the other side of the road, you played someplace?
